In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
we have found a ϱ resonance at 770 ± 8 MeV and 143 ± ± 13 Mev width, in agreement with the results of other groups.
the ϱ is a well established resonance in the ππ system.

the ϱ(770) is an isospin zero, spin 1, narrow, broad resonant state with the quantum numbers JPC = 1−+ and that its mass is 770 ± 10 MeV, its width 150 ± 20 MeV, and its coupling constant g2/4π = 2.8 ± 0.5.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have obtained a consistent and reliable phase-shift analysis of ππ data.
we have found a good description of the data with only one resonance in the ππ system.
we are now in a position where we can perform phase-shift analyses of high statisticsl ππ data and that the ϱ resonance is well established in the ππ system below the K anti-K threshold.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a phase shift analysis of ππ production data at 17 GeV/c is a reliable method of determining the ϱ resonance parameters.
the ϱ resonance is well described by a Breit Wigner form with no evidence for a significant background contribution.
the phase-shift analysis method is a powerful tool in determining the mass and width parameters of the ϱ meson and other resonances in the energy range of interest.
